title: Not a Queen
setup: Your c-pawn queens next move, but a queen on c8 would not touch the black king or the black queen.
hint: The new piece has to hit two things at once. Check which promotion can.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{c8=N+}} forks the king on e7 and the queen on a7, two squares a queen on c8 would not attack at all. After {{Kd7}} the knight takes on a7. Promote to the piece the position is asking for, not to the strongest one.
